title: Mandya
desc: Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.

title: Kotee
desc: In the corrupt city of Janatha, Kotee, an honest man, defies the ruthless criminal Dinoo Savarkar in a bid to secure a better future for his sister. However, his defiance leads to overwhelming debts.

title: Govinda Sarvarigu
desc: Abhiram decides to visit his family at their ancestral house after returning from London. However, chaos ensues when he tries to move about the village without disclosing who he is.

title: Raja Mahal
desc: Three college friends decide to open a resort. However, their lives change when they start experiencing paranormal activities in their resort.

title: Thandege Thakka Maga
desc: Sathya is forced to marry a woman from a lower caste after his father's sudden death. He struggles to lead a happy marital life while dealing with certain problems.
